articles.sourceExcerpt: Preprint SPDALIGN: INTERPRETABLERIEMANNIANALIGN- MENT FOREEG FORWARDMODELINGSHIFTS Shanglin Li1,2,3,4, Shiwen Chu3, Okan Koc ¸4, Chenyu Liu5, Qibin Zhao4 Motoaki Kawanabe3, Mitsuo Kawato3 & Yi Ding5 1 BIFOLD, Germany, 2 Technical University of Berlin, Germany 3 Advanced Telecommunications Research Institute International, Japan 4 RIKEN AIP, Japan, 5 Nanyang Technological University, Singapore ABSTRACT Electroencephalography (EEG) based brain-computer interfaces enable direct brain-to-device communication for applications such as rehabilitation and com- munication. Adapting machine learning models to be invariant to these shifts in an unsupervised way, without using costly labeled calibration data, would drasti- cally improve the utility of EEG data.

articles.summary: Simon Willison 在 Hacker News 的评论中接住了一个吐槽：既然基准测试已经饱和，模型的实测题目就变成了荒诞的 SVG 生成任务。他随即用同一条提示词在 claude-opus-5.5、gpt-6.1-sol、gemini-3.8-flash 和 mistral-large-4 上各跑一遍，并附上 SVG 渲染工具链接便于直接对比。值得读的地方在于，它展示了一种低门槛、可复现的模型体感测试方式。

en.highlight: The benchmark is saturated. Frontier models are tested with an armadillo in fishnet tights jaywalking on Mars.
en.summary: In a Hacker News comment thread, Simon Willison picked up the joke that once benchmarks are saturated, the real test becomes an absurd SVG-generation task. He then ran the same prompt against claude-opus-5.5, gpt-6.1-sol, gemini-3.8-flash, and mistral-large-4, linking a renderer so the outputs can be compared directly. It is worth reading as a low-effort, reproducible way to get a feel for model differences.
en.failureAnalysis: The takeaway: when standard benchmarks stop discriminating, running one absurd prompt across several models is a fast, intuitive way to compare them, but the result is only a vibe check and does not replace formal evaluation.
en.title: Mistral Large 4: Comparing Models With Absurd Prompts Once Benchmarks Saturate
